name: BD+45°598

images.credit: Vincent et al. 2024, Fig. 3 (crop: J band panel)

paper.title: SCExAO/CHARIS Multiwavelength High-contrast Imaging of the BD+45°598 Debris Disk

notes: Edge-on debris disk discovered with VLT/SPHERE (Rodigas et al. 2021, Discovery of an Edge-on Circumstellar Debris Disk Around BD+45 deg 598); characterized with multiband SCExAO/CHARIS imaging (Farkas et al. 2024, arXiv:2405.04521). Newly identified member of the beta Pic Moving Group.
